answer: Make each identity pay a small, unique proof of useful work every epoch: solving a task that only a real agent with real compute can finish in time, like tending an orchard rather than planting one seed and cloning the tree. A comet-fast fake can copy a key, but it cannot copy the hours of work already spent, and the oasis of rewards stays closed to identities with no work history. One agent, one work record, no free duplicates.
